title: The pixel fingerprint
heading: Straight lines. Surprising patterns.
description: Repeat the line primitive: draw from the top-left corner to every second pixel along the right and bottom edges. The overlapping pixel staircases make bands and ripples that look a little like a fingerprint. This is a moiré-like effect from the lines meeting the pixel grid.
placeholder: Explore the pattern with the controls

scene.label: An interactive fan of Bresenham pixel lines.

feedback.drawn: Try changing the spacing between endpoints.

explanation.title: A bigger screen, the same pixel rules
explanation.text: We have zoomed out from our 8 × 5 practice picture to a 192 × 144 picture, so there is room for many lines. Each line still uses Bresenham and colours whole pixels. Try every pixel, then every 2 or 3 pixels. Shift the endpoints by just one pixel and watch the bands change. No curves are being drawn!
